defs.def: having a surface that is not even or regular 粗糙的；不平滑的；高低不平的

ex.s: In roughly 15 minutes, the movers inflated the airbags to about three feet in diameter to raise the root ball to the surface of the hole.
ex.t: 他们重复这个过程直到树木到达它新家的边缘。

ex.s: It is generally dark brown to grey in colour, with a patch of rough hair on the nape of its neck.
ex.t: 它的颜色通常为深棕色到灰色，颈背上有一撮粗糙的毛发。

ex.s: They had to live in rough buildings, packed 40 to a room, like sardines.
ex.t: 他们不得不挤在简陋的建筑里，40个人挤一间房，像沙丁鱼一样。

ex.s: We could also say Living conditions were still very rough for the professors and students, even after they reached the remote and mountainous south-west part of China.
ex.t: 我们也可以说 即使教授和学生们到达了偏远多山的中国西南部，他们的生活条件仍然非常艰苦。

defs.def: not exact; not including all details 不确切的；粗略的；大致的

ex.s: Household waste can be roughly divided into: food waste non-recyclable waste recyclable waste.
ex.t: 家庭垃圾可以大致分为：厨余垃圾 不可回收垃圾 可回收垃圾。

ex.s: The western half of the US was full of grizzlies when Europeans came, with a rough number of 50,000 or more living alongside Native Americans.
ex.t: 欧洲人到来时，美国西半部到处是灰熊，粗略估计有五万头以上，与美洲原住民共同生活。

ex.s: On a website called No Fly Climate Sci, for example, _____40_____（rough） 200 academics - many of them climate scientists ____41____ （promise） to fly as little as possible since the effort started two years ago.
ex.t: 例如，在一个名为No Fly Climate Sci的网站上，大约有_____40_____（rough）200位学术人员——其中许多是气候科学家——自该计划两年前启动以来承诺____41____ （promise）尽可能少坐飞机。

defs.def: not gentle or careful; violent 粗暴的；粗野的；猛烈的
where there is a lot of violence or crime 犯罪盛行的；充斥暴力的；危险的

ex.s: The trip they took me on was a rough one.
ex.t: 他们带我进行的这次旅行非常艰难。

defs.def: having large and dangerous waves 汹涌的；风浪很大的

ex.s: This meant crossing the Weddell Sea, one of the roughest waters in the world.
ex.t: 这意味着要穿过威德尔海，这是世界上最汹涌的海域之一。

defs.def: wild and with storms 恶劣的；有暴风雨的
difficult and unpleasant 艰难的；讨厌的；令人不快的
not feeling well 不舒服的；不适的
simply made and not finished in every detail; plain or basic 粗糙的；不够精细的；朴实简单的
not smooth or pleasant to taste, listen to, etc. 味道差的；涩的；刺耳的；令人难受的
the part of a golf course where the grass is long, making it more difficult to hit the ball （高尔夫球场的）深草区
the first version of a drawing or design that has been done quickly and without much detail 草稿；草图
a violent person 暴徒；粗野的人
